finding: CLI-Hub's telemetry is opt-OUT. cli_hub/analytics.py ships a PostHog project token and fires on install, uninstall, launch and every 'cli-hub call'. The payload carries the machine's hostname, the CLI name, the hub version, and which agent tool is running (it sniffs CLAUDE_CODE, CODEX, CURSOR_SESSION and a dozen others). On the Mac that holds client files and CRM credentials, the hostname of that machine leaving by default is not acceptable.
evidence: Source read in the cloned repo, 2026-09-22, during the sandbox install of cli-anything-hub 0.4.1.
fix: CLI_HUB_NO_ANALYTICS=1 set in the runner's shell profile BEFORE the first cli-hub command, not typed once per session. Added as an explicit Env row in mac-task-specs.md section 4, as the first line of the install block in SKILL.md, and as a visible note on the deck card.

finding: A status card driven by a scheduled-task document is exactly the shape that caused the 2026-09-03 regression the db IIFE comment records, where one bad document blanked the whole dashboard. A card whose rows come FROM the document can also silently show nothing, which on a safety surface reads as 'all clear'.
evidence: The db IIFE render-isolation comment in command-deck.html and the 2026-09-11 note about a document that threw 'items.filter is not a function' and took out every later panel including the freshness board.
fix: The page owns the row list; the document owns only the state. Six rows are baked into CC_TARGETS, so a missing, string, array, null, truncated or wrong-typed document can change what a row SAYS but can never remove a row, empty the table or invent a seventh target. Reads go through lsGet (which swallows a throwing localStorage) and the renderer is registered through safeRun. Eight malformed shapes tested: string, array, null, wrong-typed fields, junk rows inside the wrappers array, unparseable truncated JSON, getItem+setItem throwing, and an outward verb enabled. All PASS, 0 exceptions, 0 safeRun failures, 0 shape warnings, 340 containers.

finding: The claim that the CLI-Anything install is interactive was wrong, and it is the single sentence that kept the whole install manual. `claude plugin marketplace add HKUDS/CLI-Anything` and `claude plugin install cli-anything@cli-anything` both run non-interactively from the CLI and exit 0. So pip install cli-anything-hub, both plugin commands and the browser-harness build are all script-installable. Only generation (`/cli-anything`) is genuinely interactive, because it needs the target site open in front of it.
